newsitem.title: USA: Enron says extends USG gas line work to Fri.
newsitem.headline: Enron says extends USG gas line work to Fri.

text.p: Enron Corp said Wednesday that unplanned maintenance on a U.S. Gulf natural gas line, which was shut January 27, has been extended to Friday.

"Maintenance on the MOPS (Matagorda Offshore Pipeline System) line is still ongoing. They're continuing to curtail approximately 200 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd)," a company spokeswoman said, adding the in service date has been extended to Friday, February 7.
The line, which runs from Mustang Island Block 831 offshore Texas to Tivoli, Texas, and operated by Enron's Houston Pipe Line unit, was originally expected to be back in service yesterday.
The curtailment affected flows south of platform 686.
